recalcPlanned.title: Recalculate planned labor hours from work lines
recalcPlanned.tooltip: When enabled, adding or removing work lines automatically raises the “Planned labor hours” field to the sum of line hours. Manual reduction is allowed.
recalcPlanned.description: When adding or removing work lines, the “Planned labor hours” field is automatically raised to the sum of line hours. If a higher value was set manually, it is not reduced automatically.

recalcActual.title: Recalculate actual labor hours from work lines
recalcActual.tooltip: When enabled, saving a work order automatically calculates the “Actual labor hours” field as the sum of lines: if a line has “Hrs (actual)” it is used, otherwise “Hrs (planned)”.
recalcActual.description: When a work order is saved, the “Actual labor hours” field is automatically calculated as the sum of work lines. For each line “Hrs (actual)” is used if filled, otherwise “Hrs (planned)”.

syncSlot.title: Sync calendar slot when work order planned hours change
syncSlot.tooltip: When enabled, saving a work order checks whether the planned dates match the calendar slots and offers to sync.
syncSlot.description: When a work order is saved, if the planned dates differ from the calendar slot, the system will offer to sync the slot.
